usedFor: SprintOps holds the sprint tasks, and Documint fills documents through “Add Content To Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new task is created” in SprintOps, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: A new task fills a document template, so the paperwork starts with the task.

watchOut: “When a task is updated” in SprintOps fires on every update, so one task can fill the template again.
